summary: W19 — the added Build load week (Adj #204) and the last full week before the W20 deload. Mon's long is banked but under-filled: 60:00 ran against the 70-min ask (Adj #309), so the week lands ~24 mi and its entire easy fraction is ~14% short — no make-up, §11.D drops missed easy volume and no slot exists to repay it into. What ran was the best-quality long of the v4.4 era: every full mile inside the easy band at RPE 4, 10 s/mi quicker than W18 at a lower effort read, and the standing Achilles read at ~40 h off Saturday's calf 365 dose CLOSED CLEAN, so 365 holds Sat (Adj #310). The week's centerpiece is the §10 5K-pace cut-down Wed 8-26, which now arbitrates T alone: W18 validated the stepped 7:40–7:45 band (Adj #291) and settled I at 7:00–7:15 outright (Adj #296). Validity rests on hitting the M and T miles on pace before the goal-pace mile (Adj #292). Fri runs the 2nd exposure of 5×1000m @ I, opened at 7:00 with 90 s jog recoveries. Four lift decisions fire across the two lift days: preacher 75 and the rope pushdown dose call Tue, lat 170 and the DB lateral revert to 35 Sat.

days.note: Logged — 60:00 / 6.10 mi @ 9:49/mi + 0.43 mi / 4:02 jogged CD = 6.53 mi / 64:02. UNDER-FILLED: the work interval was set to 60:00 against the 70-min ask, ~10 min / ~1.0 mi short — dropped, not repaid (§11.D), W19 lands ~24 mi. Splits 9:24 / 9:27 / 9:46 / 10:20 / 10:16 / 9:46 + 0.54 mi @ 9:14/mi, RPE 4 — all six full miles inside the 9:15–10:30 band, fastest 9 s/mi clear of the fast edge, so the Adj #256/#283 pickup pattern stays closed. Ran 10 s/mi quicker than W18 at a lower effort read, HR 164 work avg (5 under W18), power 203 W, cadence 167–170 inside the easy allowance; CD jogged at 9:17/mi, the first jogged CD on a v4.4 long. Road, Vomero Plus; all clean by default — first run after the 8-22 calf 365 dose at ~40 h, the standing Achilles read CLOSED CLEAN, 365 holds W19 Sat (Adj #309/#310).

Incline repeats 1×5 @ 160 + AMRAP @ 135 — ≥RIR 2 → 165, <5 reps = §5 miss #2 (Adj #285); preacher 75 FIRES (Adj #287); pushdown is a load-or-set-count call on the two-handed rope — 45–50 for four sets or 55 for three (Adj #304); DB lateral 35, rear-delt 145, crunch +10 hold.
